ui.settings.models.hint: Through the provider configured for each role. Applies from the next agent call.
ui.settings.role.deep.hint: Investigates in depth, reading the spec, {vcsName} and the playbook. Worth a stronger model.

ui.settings.start.autostartHint: Starts in the tray only, without a window. Applies right away, no need to save.

ui.settings.theme.systemHint: Follows the computer's light or dark setting.

ui.settings.tool.skills.hint: Load skills as in Claude Code.

ui.settings.voice.autoStopHint: Once you start talking, a long pause sends what you said. Each speech lasts at most 30 seconds.
ui.settings.voice.autoStopLabel: Send on its own when I stop talking
ui.settings.voice.bargeInHint: When you talk over the agent, it stops and recording starts, as if you pressed space. It is more reliable with headphones: on speakers the echo of its voice can get in the way.
ui.settings.voice.bargeInLabel: Interrupt the agent when I talk
ui.settings.voice.engineHintEdge: Sounds more natural, but the spoken text goes to Microsoft. To keep everything on your machine, use Kokoro.
ui.settings.voice.engineHintKokoro: Runs on your machine: nothing leaves it. Sounds a bit more robotic, and the first speech takes longer because it loads the model.
ui.settings.voice.glossaryHint: How the voice pronounces terms like QA, merge and deploy, and how to fix what the transcription mishears.
ui.settings.voice.prosodyHint: Each sentence comes out with its own pace and tone: a question rises, a blocker slows down, good news brightens, and there are pauses between sentences and list items.
ui.settings.voice.prosodyHintKokoro: Each sentence comes out with its own pace and tone: a question rises, a blocker slows down, good news brightens, and there are pauses between sentences and list items. In Kokoro only the pace changes: it does not adjust the tone.
ui.settings.voice.speakHint: When off, everything stays on screen (transcript, questions, answers) and no text is synthesized. The microphone keeps working.
ui.verify.empty: This workspace lists no repository with a remote yet. Type a project below (group/project) to give it a command.
ui.verify.hint: Shell command that runs in the conflict worktree, after the resolution is applied and before the merge commit. Empty: no verification (the app asks for a “go without tests”). Variables: CLONE_DIR (your clone, where node_modules can be linked from) and WORKTREE_DIR. Example for a project that only tests on Node 18: {command}

ui.verify.title: Conflict verification
ui.verify.unclaimed.hint: These projects were in the file every workspace used to share and are not a repository or mirror of any workspace. Nothing was deleted: the original stays in the data folder as conflict-verify.json.migrated. Use one here to keep it in this workspace.
ui.verify.unclaimed.title: Commands from the earlier shared list
